# `languages/ci/nix:T155`: a sink value built with `+` is shell in EVERY
# string operand, however many there are, and through the parentheses a
# positional builder argument needs. A string reached through a function
# call (`optionalString`) is that function's argument, not an operand of
# the concatenation, and is not a site.
shell.shellHook | '' | bash | - | "\n      [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env\n    "
shell.shellHook | " | bash | - | "export A=1"
greet.writeShellScript | '' | bash | - | "\n      echo hi\n    "
